note: Which Wikimedia Commons file goes on which page. Only what a person has to decide is written here: the file, the page, the alt text, and, when the caption names a place, the box [south, west, north, east] the camera must have stood in. Author, licence, source and dates are read from Commons on every run by scripts/fetch-photos.mjs and are never typed here. A file whose licence or terms stop qualifying drops off the next build.
